newsitem.title: USA: And now, Tropical Storm Hortense.
newsitem.headline: And now, Tropical Storm Hortense.

text.p: A tropical depression in the Atlantic increased in strength on Saturday and became Tropical Storm Hortense, the National Hurricane Center said.
At 9 a.m. EDT (1300 GMT), Hortense was located about 200 miles (320 km) east of the Caribbean's Leeward Islands, at latitude 15.6 north and longitude 59.9 west.
The storm was packing winds of about 40 mph (65 kmh) and moving west to west-northwest at 13 mph (20 kmh).
Hortense gathered strength in the wake of Hurricane Fran, which hit the U.S. coast on Thursday, wreaking havoc through the Carolinas and leaving at least 12 people dead.
